items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: He held my hand and showed me the second position... He said, I'm going to give you this... come up here twice a week.

ctx.x: For me, my name is Albert Warner. Albert Warner. Albert Warner. Albert Warner. Any middle name?

No, any middle name. Born in New Orleans, Louisiana. December 31st, 1890. When I first started learning music was with a half brother of mine. He learned from Henri Dutre. Well when he left, before he left he bought him a new trombone. And a boy wanted to buy his old trombone from him. And he refused to sell it to him. He paid one against his brother. Well, he sent downtown, got me, and I went on up to his house to see what it was all about. I got there, he gave me this little old brass horn with about a bell the…
Had you played anything before that at all, like drums or guitar or anything?
